# Biolayne

> > Evidence-based fitness education and coaching from Dr. Layne Norton and Team Biolayne, covering muscle growth, nutrition science, and training optimization.

Biolayne is the platform of Dr. Layne Norton and his team, providing research-backed articles on hypertrophy, nutrition, contest preparation, and fitness coaching. The site combines scientific expertise with practical coaching programs, debunking fitness myths while offering actionable strategies for muscle growth and body composition management.

## Key Topics

- Hypertrophy
- Progressive Overload
- Protein Nutrition
- Training Recovery
- DOMS (Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness)
- Strength Training
- Contest Prep
- Exercise Physiology
- Muscle Damage
- Performance Optimization
- IIFYM (If It Fits Your Macros)
- Eccentric Training
- Fasted Training
- Periodization
- Coaching Ethics

## Training & Muscle Growth

- [7 Proven Tips & Techniques to Boost Muscle Growth](https://biolayne.com/articles/training/7-proven-tips-techniques-boost-muscle-growth): Seven science-backed techniques for optimizing muscle growth and hypertrophy.
- [What is the most optimal rep range for muscle growth?](https://biolayne.com/articles/training/optimal-rep-range-muscle-growth): Research-backed guide on rep ranges for optimal muscle hypertrophy.
- [Three More Metrics for Progressive Overload](https://biolayne.com/articles/training/three-metrics-progressive-overload): Progressive overload metrics beyond weight using ROM and exercise variation.
- [Weekly Undulating Periodization is Superior to Block Periodization for Maximal Strength and Hypertrophy in Females](https://biolayne.com/articles/research/weekly-undulating-periodization-superior-block-periodization-maximal-strength-hypertrophy-females): Research review on periodization effectiveness for female strength and hypertrophy.
- [Three Ways to Add Variety to Your Training](https://biolayne.com/articles/training/three-ways-add-variety-training): Training variety strategies using law of accommodation for progression.
- [Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness (DOMS) and The Repeated Bout Effect](https://biolayne.com/articles/training/doms-repeated-bout-effect): Dr. Fitschen explains DOMS science and repeated bout effect for muscle gains.
- [The Dangers of Improper Breathing Technique](https://biolayne.com/articles/training/dangers-improper-breathing-technique): Science of breathing mechanics and impact on health and performance.

## Nutrition & Supplementation

- [A Primer on Fasting and Time-Restricted Eating](https://biolayne.com/articles/nutrition/a-primer-on-fasting-and-time-restricted-eating): Research-based primer on intermittent fasting and time-restricted eating.
- [Training Fasted: Can You Still Make Gains?](https://biolayne.com/articles/nutrition/training-fasted-can-you-still-make-gains): Science on fasted training and muscle gains with pre-workout nutrition.
- [Fat Facts: Why Fat Source Matters](https://biolayne.com/articles/nutrition/fat-facts-fat-source-matters): Analysis of dietary fat sources and their impact on flexible dieting.
- [5 Key Minerals You Need in Your Diet](https://biolayne.com/articles/supplementation/5-key-minerals-need-diet): Guide to essential minerals and micronutrients for athletes and fitness.

## Protein Science & Myth Busting

- [Protein Experts Respond to Recent Anti-Protein Claims](https://biolayne.com/blog/broscience-busted/protein-metabolism-experts-respond-to-recent-anti-protein-claims): Expert response to anti-protein claims with protein metabolism research review.
- [Low Protein Diet helpful for kidneys? I don't think so!](https://biolayne.com/blog/broscience-busted/low-protein-diet-helpful-for-kidneys-i-dont-think-so): Debunking protein myths: high protein diets and kidney health research.

## Contest Preparation & Coaching

- [Winter 2025 16 Week Diet and Lifestyle Remodel](https://biolayne.com/blog/news/winter-2025-16-week-diet-and-lifestyle-remodel): 16-week coaching program registration with Layne Norton and Team Biolayne.
- [Maximizing Offseason Body Comp](https://biolayne.com/articles/contest-prep/maximizing-offseason-body-comp): Strategies for maintaining physique year-round with body composition management.
- [Steroids and Coaching Ethics](https://biolayne.com/articles/contest-prep/steroids-coaching-ethics): Ethics of steroid use and coaching responsibility in fitness industry.
